batch: Beijing visitor information review: Jingshan, Tian'anmen Square, and 798·751 Zone
scope: Official Beijing municipal English sources reviewed for selected descriptive and visitor-information claims. Dynamic ticketing, reservation, and hours information must be rechecked before travel; this batch is not a live availability check.

records.name: Jingshan Park
claimsReviewed: Park is located on Beijing's central north-south axis and was an imperial garden in the Yuan, Ming, and Qing dynasties
Address is listed as No. 44 Jingshanxi Street, Xicheng District, Beijing
Official sources list seasonal opening hours and a standard adult ticket price of CNY 2, with student ticket CNY 1

Official sources differ on foreign visitor reservation requirements: one current park guide describes online booking or onsite ticket purchase, while another municipal page says foreign visitors should call at least one day in advance
records.source: Beijing Municipal Government English portal / Visit Beijing park guide
records.notes: Keep reservation requirement flagged as conflicting and dynamic. Do not present a single requirement as definitive; users should check the park's current official channel before visiting.

records.name: Tian'anmen Square
claimsReviewed: Official municipal guide lists address as East Chang'an Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing
Official guide lists opening hours as 05:00-22:00 and free admission
Official visitor guide identifies reservation channels including the Tian'anmen Square Visit Reservation mini-program and Jing Tong channels
Municipal FAQ notes the web reservation portal does not support non-Chinese phone numbers and recommends the WeChat mini-program personal reservation flow or authorization by another person
records.source: Beijing Municipal Government English portal and 12345 FAQ
records.notes: Reservation policy and channels may change. Flag-raising ceremony access and security arrangements are time-specific; check the official reservation platform.

records.name: 798·751 Zone / 798 Art Zone
claimsReviewed: Official guide lists address at 2 and 4 Jiuxianqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing
General entry to the art zone is free and listed as all-day access
Individual exhibitions and events may require reservation or paid tickets
records.source: Beijing Municipal Government English portal / Visit Beijing
records.notes: Free general-area access does not mean every gallery, exhibition, or event is free or open. Venue-level schedules must be checked individually.
